Name: As's dsp Greenhouse
Author: Awassakura
Description:
[size=6]Introduction:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿A greenhouse where all the original crops can be planted and displayed. 
﻿This greenhouse can accommodate 73 iridium sprinklers and 64 fruit trees, and it has teleportation crystals for quick transportation, saving time.
[color=#d9ead3]Supported in version 1.6.11.[/color]


[/size][size=6]简介：
[/size] [size=3]﻿可以种下原版所有作物的巨大温室。
﻿可以放下73个铱洒和64个果树，有传送水晶可以传送，节约路程。
支持星露谷1.6.11

[/size]

[size=6]How to Download:[/size][list=1]
[*]Download and install SMAPI.
[*]Download and install Content Patcher.
[*]Download and unzip this mod, then place it into the Mods folder.
[/list]
[size=6]如何下载：[/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3]下载安装SMAPI。[/size]
[*][size=3]下载安装Content Patcher（常说的CPmod）。[/size]
[*][size=3]下载本mod，解压到Mods文件夹里即可。[/size]
[/list]
[size=6]
About：[/size]
[size=3] ﻿﻿This greenhouse replaces the original greenhouse in the game, so [color=#ffe599]if you have other mods that replace the original greenhouse[/color], [color=#ffe599]please delete those mods and only keep this one,[/color] otherwise it may cause loading errors and display the original greenhouse in the game.
﻿It is  recommended to experience this mod with [color=#ffe599]a save file that has not yet unlocked the greenhouse[/color], otherwise it may very likely cause graphical errors in the game, affecting the gaming experience.
The Immersive Farm 2 mod comes with a greenhouse. If you want to experience both Immersive Farm 2 and this mod at the same time, you need to disable the greenhouse of Immersive Farm 2 in the Generic Mod Config Menu (or in config file), otherwise, it will cause an error.

﻿(Of course, if you want to experience other mods that have replaced the original greenhouse, you will also need to delete the other mods that have modified the original greenhouse, and only keep the mod you want to experience.)
[/size]
[size=6]相关内容：[/size]
[size=3] ﻿这个温室替换了游戏原有的温室，[color=#ffe599]如果你有其他修改游戏原有温室的mod，你需要删除它们，仅保留本mod[/color]，以体验这个温室，否则可能会加载错误，显示游戏原有的温室。
﻿建议[color=#ffe599]使用还未解锁温室的存档来体验这个mod[/color]，否则可能会出现贴图加载错误，影响游戏体验，
﻿沉浸式农场2自带一个温室，如果想同时体验沉浸式农场2和本mod，需要在通用模组配置菜单（GMCM）中关闭沉浸式农场2的温室，否则会报错的。
（当然，如果你想体验其他修改了原有温室的mod，你也需要删除其他修改了原有温室的mod，仅保留你想体验的mod。）[/size]
